description: This file defines classes and functions related to a voice push-to-talk feature for a macOS application. It includes a hotkey handler that monitors the right Option key as a push-to-talk trigger, and an actor that manages voice recording and speech recognition sessions while the hotkey is held.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: Handles monitoring of the right Option key as a hotkey for push-to-talk functionality, starting or stopping voice recognition sessions accordingly.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalk
classes.description: Manages voice recording and speech recognition, handling the lifecycle of a push-to-talk session including starting/stopping recognition, processing speech transcripts, and managing associated UI overlays and chimes.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the global hotkey monitoring.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Begins listening for modifier key events to trigger push-to-talk.

methods.name: handleFlagsChanged
methods.description: Handles modifier key state changes, primarily the right Option key.

methods.name: updateModifierState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on the key code and modifier flags, and triggers speech recognition start/stop accordingly.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Initiates a speech recognition session when the hotkey is pressed.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the current speech recognition session when the hotkey is released.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognizer and audio engine.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles partial and final speech recognition transcripts during a session.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the speech recognition session, processes the final transcript, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: makeConfig
methods.description: Constructs the configuration for speech recognition based on current app state.

methods.name: _testDelta
methods.description: Test helper to compute the delta between committed and current transcripts.

methods.name: _testAttributedColors
methods.description: Test helper to get attributed text colors for final and partial recognition results.
